# Omar Husain — Premium Websites with 3D & AI

> Voice-first portfolio and lead engine. The site demonstrates the same AI + 3D stack built for clients.

## Site

- Home: https://omar-web-five.vercel.app/
- Contact email: omar.oi.web@gmail.com

## Sections

- **Home / Hero** — 3D interactive scene, voice assistant intro
- **Services** — 3D & motion, integrated AI, performance, design & UX
- **Work** — portfolio / case studies
- **Process** — discovery, design & build, launch & grow
- **Pricing** — Landing, Signature (flagship), Custom tiers (scoped per project)
- **FAQ** — pricing, timeline, process, AI assistants
- **Contact** — book a call or email

## Voice & chat capabilities

The AI assistant can:

- Navigate any section by voice ("show pricing", "go to contact")
- Read section content aloud
- Highlight pricing tiers and service cards
- Run a guided site tour ("give me a tour")
- Book discovery calls via Google Calendar
- Capture project leads (name, email, message)
- Control the 3D hero scene (speed, color)
- Answer FAQ questions

## Booking

- Weekday slots: 10:00 AM, 1:00 PM, 3:30 PM (America/New_York)
- Book via voice, chat, or the appointment modal
- Confirmation emails via Resend

## Tech

- Next.js, React Three Fiber, @ais-os/site-agent
- Claude (chat/tools), ElevenLabs (TTS), Web Speech API / Whisper STT fallback
- Google Calendar, Resend
